function[T0, T1: lib(order).PartialOrder] { forall(x0: T0 -> T1, x1: T0 -> T1) { forall(x2: T0) { x0(x2) < x1(x2) } = lib(order_iso).function_order_lt[T0, T1](x0, x1) } }

function[T0, T1: lib(algebra.add_comm_monoid).AddCommMonoid] { forall(x0: lib(list).List[T0], x1: lib(list).List[T0], x2: T0 -> T1) { not forall(x3: T0) { x3 ∈ x0 = x3 ∈ x1 } or not x0.is_unique or not x1.is_unique or lib(list).sum[T1](lib(list).map[T0, T1](x0, x2)) = lib(list).sum[T1](lib(list).map[T0, T1](x1, x2)) } }

function[T0, T1: lib(algebra.add_comm_monoid).AddCommMonoid] { forall(x0: lib(list).List[T0], x1: lib(list).List[T0], x2: T0 -> T1) { not x0.is_unique or not x1.is_unique or exists(k0: T0) { k0 ∈ x0 != k0 ∈ x1 } or lib(list).sum[T1](lib(list).map[T0, T1](x0, x2)) = lib(list).sum[T1](lib(list).map[T0, T1](x1, x2)) } }
